protocol.name: dsk_app_menu_v1
protocol.copyright: Copyright © 2026 the desktop project authors SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

description.summary: a window's menubar, shown by the desktop shell

protocol.description:
A client sends the menu tree of one toplevel. The compositor keeps it and the shell shows it in its global menu bar while that toplevel has focus. When the user picks an item, the client gets an activated event on the same object.
Only unsandboxed clients see this global.

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: the toplevel already has a dsk_app_menu_v1

request.name: get_menu
request.description: One dsk_app_menu_v1 per xdg_toplevel; a second one is an already_exists error.

interface.name: dsk_app_menu_v1

description.summary: the menu tree of one toplevel

interface.description: The tree is double-buffered: item requests build a pending tree and commit makes it current. A commit with no items removes the menu. Items appear in request order under their parent.

entry.name: invalid_item
entry.summary: id is 0 or repeated, or the parent was not sent before in this tree

entry.name: too_large
entry.summary: more than 1024 items in one tree

entry.name: separator
entry.summary: a separator line; label is ignored

entry.name: disabled
entry.summary: shown greyed out; cannot be activated

entry.name: checkable
entry.summary: shows a check mark when checked

entry.name: radio
entry.summary: shows a radio mark when checked

entry.name: checked
entry.summary: the check or radio mark is on

request.name: destroy
request.description: The shell stops showing the menu.

request.name: item

description.summary: add an item to the pending tree

request.description: parent 0 puts the item in the bar. An item that is a parent of others opens a submenu. The shortcut is display text, for example "Ctrl+Q", or empty.

arg.name: parent
arg.summary: id of an item sent before, or 0

event.name: activated
event.description: id is an item of the current tree that is not disabled and has no children.
